title: SlipSurfaceIQ LE: 2D limit equilibrium slope stability analysis with a desktop CAD interface
description: SlipSurfaceIQ LE is an open-source Python program for two-dimensional limit equilibrium slope stability analysis of soil and rock slopes, cuts and embankments, with a bilingual (English/Turkish) desktop CAD interface, a global critical-surface search and PDF reporting.

creators.name: Altuntaş, Hasan Deniz
creators.affiliation: General Directorate of Highways (KGM), 13th Regional Directorate, Antalya, Türkiye
